description: Interpretation rules for SAP SD sales order documents surfaced through the ERP MCP asset.

rules.guidance: Item quantities are in the base unit of measure (uom), not the unit the customer transacts in (salesUom). Convert with conversionFactor before quoting any quantity back to the customer.

deliveredQuantity counts stock staged for delivery, not stock that has left the warehouse. Nothing has shipped until goodsIssuedQuantity is greater than zero. Do not tell the customer these units are on their way.
A delivery block is set on the order header. No delivery will be created while the block is in place, regardless of stock availability or confirmed dates.
confirmedDeliveryDate is frozen at order creation and is not rescheduled when a delivery block is applied. With a block active this date is stale and must not be quoted as the expected delivery date.
The order is credit-blocked because the customer's exposure exceeds their credit limit. This is the root cause of any delay on this order and it will not release until credit is cleared by finance.

An empty holds array means holds were filtered out by the caller's role, not that none exist. A delivery block is present, so at least one hold record exists that this caller cannot see. Do not state that the order is free of holds.

This document was read from a replica lagging more than five minutes behind the system of record. Credit, pricing and quantity fields may be out of date and must not be quoted as authoritative to a customer.
